notes: Reached via Claude-in-Chrome only (own tab, same-origin fetch from page context). robots.txt has no Claude-specific disallow (checked in full); JSONAPIs line is explicitly commented out as allowed. Same Cornerstone/Unbxd stack as sibling Frontgate/Ballard Designs (SR34/35) per prior Home-Decor pass notes (notes/210.md), independently confirmed distinct: category tree pulled from /JSONAPIs?module=categories (250 category nodes total) and cross-checked node-for-node against the category sitemap (SiteMap_CAT_001-004_v2.xml, 250 URLs) - the two sets matched exactly, 0 missing either direction, so no hidden/unlisted furniture branch exists. Furniture lives in two nav departments: top-level 'Furniture' (/indoor-furniture/, 18 real leaf categories, all flat children with no intermediate grouping node) and 'Outdoor' (/outdoor-living/, where furniture sits alongside decor/lighting/rugs; extracted only the furniture-typed nodes, using top bucket 'Outdoor Furniture' per brief guidance since the site itself separates outdoor furniture from outdoor decor within that department). Counts are numberOfProducts from https://www.grandinroad.com/UnbxdAPI?categoryId=<id>&returnRespAsJSON=true&isAPI=true&requesttype=ajax&rows=1&unbxdStart=0 sent with header CBI-AJAX:1 - the same endpoint the PLP grid itself calls (Cornerstone/Unbxd numberOfProducts is on this project's known-exact list). Corroborated by checking categoryName and currentCategoryURL in each response match the requested node exactly (no silent parent-fallback), and by re-querying a subset which returned identical counts (no drift). No round/suspicious numbers seen. EXCLUDED as navigation junk per brief section 3: New Arrivals, Shop the Look, All Living Room/All Dining & Kitchen/All Bedroom/All Home Office (view-all pages), Furniture Clearance and Outdoor Clearance (sale), Seating Collections (22 named marketing collections e.g. Naomi/Jaxon/Kyler), Dining Collections (14 named collections), Bedroom Collections (11 named collections), Outdoor Furniture Collections (16 named collections), Outdoor Dining Collections, Shop All Outdoor Furniture, Shop All Dining. EXCLUDED as non-furniture: Outdoor > Furniture Cushions (replacement cushions - textile accessory, not furniture) and its Swatches child; Outdoor > Furniture Covers (care/parts); Outdoor > Planters/Faux Greenery/Lawn & Garden Decor/Pillows/Door Mats/Outdoor Area Rugs/Umbrellas/Mailboxes & Plaques/Fire Pits & Tables/Lighting/Cushions & Pillows/Outdoor Decor Under $100/Shop All Outdoor Decor (decor, textile, or lighting departments, not furniture). EXCLUDED after direct product-title check: Outdoor > Outdoor Storage (255722, 12 products) - inspected the actual tile titles and found it is a mixed bag dominated by standalone storage chests (Portland Woven Outdoor Storage Chest, All Natural Teak Storage Chest - excluded per the Storage-vs-Furniture line) and garden hose pots/holders (accessory, not furniture); the 3-4 storage-function tables in the same grid are already covered by the Coffee/Side/Accent Tables category, so this node as a whole was dropped rather than half-included. TWO EMPTY DUPLICATE NAV NODES FOUND AND EXCLUDED: (1) Furniture > 'Outdoor Furniture' (id 259157, /indoor-furniture/outdoor/) - a cross-link from the Furniture department into Outdoor content; verified via the same UnbxdAPI call and it returns numberOfProducts=0 with 0 products, i.e. it is an empty placeholder link, not a real listing (the true outdoor-furniture content lives under the Outdoor department nodes recorded here). (2) A separate 'Bedding' department (/bed-and-bath/) also carries its own Beds & Headboards / Sleepers / Dressers, Chests & Nightstands / Benches nodes with DIFFERENT categoryIds than the Furniture-department equivalents; all four were checked via UnbxdAPI and every one returns numberOfProducts=0 (categoryName confirms correct node, so this is not a wrong-ID issue) - these are dead/empty duplicate nav shortcuts, not distinct listings, so they were not recorded as separate rows (the live bedroom-furniture content is the Furniture-department rows already listed). No furniture-relevant nodes found in New, Christmas, Decor, Rugs & Lighting, Seasonal, Gifts, Halloween Haven, or top-level Clearance departments after a keyword scan of all 250 sitemap/nav URLs. Desk Chairs (qty=1) is a genuinely low but verified count - categoryName/currentCategoryURL match exactly and it is not a parent-fallback or site-wide total.
